label: Stop (止まれ / STOP)
meaning: Come to a complete stop at the designated stopping point.
visualDescription: Red inverted triangle with white Japanese 止まれ and optional STOP text.
shortAlert: Stop sign ahead. Come to a complete stop.
explanation: Come to a complete stop at the stop line, or immediately before the intersection when no line is present.
conditions: Stop at the designated stopping point.

label: Maximum speed 30 km/h
meaning: Do not exceed 30 kilometers per hour.
visualDescription: White circle with a red border and blue 30 numerals.
shortAlert: Speed limit is 30 kilometers per hour.
explanation: The displayed number specifies the maximum permitted speed.
conditions: Applies where the 30 km/h sign is posted.

label: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: A pedestrian crossing is present; stop and give way when pedestrians are about to cross.
visualDescription: Blue sign with a white walking-person symbol.
shortAlert: Pedestrian crossing ahead. Be ready to stop.
explanation: At pedestrian crossings, stop and give way when pedestrians are crossing or about to cross.

label: No Parking
visualDescription: Blue circle with a red border and one red diagonal slash.
shortAlert: No parking where this sign applies.
explanation: The sign prohibits parking of vehicles.
conditions: Check supplementary plates for times or vehicle conditions.

label: No U-turn
visualDescription: Blue circular sign with a white U-turn arrow crossed by a red slash.
shortAlert: No U-turn where this sign applies.
explanation: Vehicles must not make a U-turn where this sign applies.

label: Stop
meaning: Come to a complete stop at the designated stop line.
visualDescription: Red octagon with a white border and STOP in white.
shortAlert: Stop sign ahead. Come to a complete stop.
explanation: The LTO manual identifies the stop sign as requiring the driver to stop at the designated stop line.
conditions: Stop at the designated stop line.

label: Maximum speed 50 km/h
meaning: Do not exceed 50 kilometers per hour.
visualDescription: White circle with a red border and black 50 numerals, sometimes paired with SPEED LIMIT wording.
shortAlert: Speed limit is 50 kilometers per hour.
explanation: The displayed number specifies the maximum permitted speed.
conditions: Applies where the 50 km/h sign is posted.

label: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: A pedestrian crossing is ahead or present.
visualDescription: Yellow diamond warning sign with a black walking-person symbol and optional PED XING wording.
shortAlert: Pedestrian crossing ahead. Slow down and watch for people.
explanation: This warning sign indicates a pedestrian crossing area.
conditions: Watch for pedestrians at the crossing.

label: No Parking
visualDescription: White rectangular sign with red NO PARKING text or a crossed P symbol.
shortAlert: No parking where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual lists No Parking among parking and stopping signs.
conditions: Check any schedule or supplementary plate.

label: No U-turn
visualDescription: White circle with a red border and slash over a black U-turn arrow, sometimes with text.
shortAlert: No U-turn where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual identifies this sign as prohibiting U-turns.
